pages.text: The compass points to your next checkpoint, then extraction. It follows a route, not a lodestone.
pages.title: Heartwood
Follow the thorn
pages.text: Its hovering ember tells height: above the needle means the target is higher; below means it is lower. Near your elevation, it settles around the center.

pages.title: Follow the thorn
pages.text: Hold use to attune. The ember climbs or sinks and the chimes rise or fall. Release to quiet it.

pages.title: Read the country
pages.text: The compass gives a bearing, not a walkable path. Go around cliffs, find a stair through caves, and treat lava as lava.

pages.title: Read the country
pages.text: Routes are checked against the destination's real terrain. A ceiling is not a surface to stand upon. Dimensions with unfamiliar terrain may still refuse a route safely.

pages.title: Read the country
pages.text: The terminal recalls its compass when the expedition ends.
